# Data Source: catalyst_pipeline

Read an existing Catalyst pipeline by ID. Requires `ZohoCatalyst.pipeline.READ` and project access. Returns the pipeline identity, name and status. Uses the documented read API without triggering the pipeline. Verified offline.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "edson-edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

data "catalyst_pipeline" "existing" {
  project_id = "123456789"
  id         = "234567890"
}

output "pipeline" {
  value = data.catalyst_pipeline.existing.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `id` (String) Existing pipeline's positive numeric ID as a string.
- `project_id` (String) Existing Catalyst project's positive numeric ID as a string.

## Attribute Reference

- `name` (String) Pipeline name reported by Catalyst.
- `status` (String) Pipeline status, when reported.
